main_text.l: Metropolis ciuitas Agrippina, id est Colonia.
Secunda Prouincia habet ciuitates numero viii.
Ciuitas Augusta Vindelicum, id est Auuerpurch.
Prouincia Batauiorum, id est Noricus Ripensis super Danubium; siue
Noricum Mediterraneum habet ciuitates numero vi.
Metropolis ciuitas Iuuauo, id est Salzburg.
Prouincia Sequanorum habet ciuitates numero vii.
Prouincia Alpium Penninitarum habet ciuitates numero ii.
Metropolis ciuitas Centronium, id est Darantasia.
Prouincia Meninsis habet ciuitates numero x.
Ciuitas Carpentoratensis, quae nunc Vitasia dicitur.

page.notes: The first lines are cut off at the left edge of the scan; the reading "Veremundu" and several place names are doubtful due to faded print and a bleed-through from the reverse. Mixed italic and roman type throughout; some numerals in the text are uncertain. Lines were transcribed as list entries because they are short, separate lines.
